name: confluence
label: Confluence
description: Lets Copilot chats search and read Confluence pages with `confluence …`, read only, through Atlassian's MCP server and your own login.

CONFLUENCE_SITE.label: Confluence site (optional)
CONFLUENCE_SITE.hint: Your site's address, like acme.atlassian.net. Only needed when your login sees more than one site; otherwise the one it sees is used.

CONFLUENCE_MCP_URL.label: MCP server (advanced)
CONFLUENCE_MCP_URL.hint: Atlassian's remote MCP server. Leave empty for https://mcp.atlassian.com/v2/mcp.
CONFLUENCE_MCP_URL.patternHint: the address should start with https://

CONFLUENCE_MCP_SCOPES.label: Scopes (advanced)
CONFLUENCE_MCP_SCOPES.hint: Read-only Confluence scopes if empty.Space-separated scopes asked for at login. If empty, Clearsky asks for the scopes the server lists that read or search Confluence, plus staying logged in: nothing that writes, and no Jira. The door uses only read-only tools either way.

secrets.note: your Atlassian login for the MCP server (and the client it registered), in ~/.config/clearsky/confluence-mcp.json

doors.name: confluence
doors.about: searches and reads Confluence pages as you, read only; no writes and no Jira

note: Reaches Atlassian's MCP server with your login. Only its read-only Confluence tools are used; secrets it knows the shape of are removed from what comes back, and every call is in Copilot's changes.
outside: It reads Confluence with your login for chats that can't hold it, which is what a door is for.
